genius_data.lyrics:
[緑黄色社会「Mela!」歌詞]

今なんじゃない？
メラメラとたぎれ
眠っているだけの正義
こんな僕も君のヒーローになりたいのさ

かっこいい君には
僕じゃ頼りないのかなんて
そりゃそうだよな
だって今もこうして迷ってる

手を取ってくれないか
ギブとテイクさ
君が僕のヒーローだったように

今なんじゃない？
メラメラとたぎる
こんな僕にも潜む正義が
どうしようもない衝動に駆られて
ほら気付けば手を握っている
いったいぜんたい
そんなに荷物を背負い込んでどこへ行くの
ねえねえ待って僕にちょっと預けてみては？

信じてばかりの僕と
信じることが怖い君と
どちらが正しいのかなんて
誰にも分からないさ

僕らだけの世界
ギブとテイクさ
補い合えた暁には同じ夢を見たい

君はかっこいいと苦しめて
ひとりぼっちにさせたのは
少し僕のせいなんだよなごめんね
だけど見るべきはリアルだ
今こそ僕が救けるんだ
抱えないで信じて頼ってほしいんだ

今なんじゃない？
メラメラとたぎる
こんな僕にも潜む正義が
どうしようもない衝動に駆られて
ほら気付けば手を握っている
ほっておけない
そんなに荷物を背負い込んでどこへ行くの
ほんのちょっと僕にちょっと預けてみては？
こんな僕も君のヒーローになりたいのさ

translated_lyrics: [緑黄色社会「Mela!」歌詞]
Isn't it just now?
Burning bright and overflowing
Justice asleep, powerless and still
I wish I could be your hero, even if I'm just like this.
So cool, you are
Does it seem like I'm not reliable at all?
Of course, that's how it is.
Because even now I'm lost, wandering like this
Won't you take my hand?
Give and take, endlessly intertwined
Just as you were my hero
Isn't it just now?
Burning bright with passion
A justice even I, in my flawed state, harbor within me
Overwhelmed by an irresistible urge
Before I knew it, our hands were intertwined
What on earth is happening?
What are you carrying so much on your back, where are you going?
Hey, hey, wait a minute why don't you leave him with me for a bit?
I, who have only ever believed in you
The you who fears believing in anything
Who's to say which is right?
No one understands, not even you.
Our little world, just ours
Give and take, endlessly intertwined
When we've made up for each other's losses, I want to share the same dream with you.
You torment me by being so effortlessly handsome
It was you who left me all alone
It's a little my fault, I'm sorry.
But what we must see is reality
This is the moment I can save you now.
Please don't hold back believe in me and lean on me.
Isn't it just now?
Burning bright with passion
A justice even I, in my flawed state, harbor within me
Overwhelmed by an irresistible urge
Before I knew it, our hands were intertwined
I can't leave you behind
What are you carrying so much on your back, where are you going?
Why don't you let me hold onto just a little bit of you?
I wish I could be your hero, even if I'm just like this.
